name: Sentence-level scoring replication (ours_sent vs EXIT, ours_sent vs reranker_sent)
fixed: 2026-09-30, before any of these documents were evaluated (docs/PREREG_SENTENCE_REPLICATION.md)
documents: test split, per source the documents ranked 501-2500 in hash order (select --n 2000 --offset 500); vimqa has 199 (501-699)
amended: 2026-10-01, families R4-R7 added before any replication document was evaluated and before span_ans_sent / fuse_sent were evaluated anywhere (docs/PREREG_SENTENCE_REPLICATION.md section 9); R1-R3 unchanged

families.name: R1
families.claim: ours_sent not worse than EXIT by more than 0.02 token F1 at 8x (primary reader)

families.name: R2
families.claim: ours_sent > reranker_sent at 8x: utility labels beat relevance at sentence level (primary reader)

families.name: R3
families.claim: R1 on the held-out reader Qwen3-32B (no labels from it)

families.name: R4
families.claim: ours_beta > reranker (its untrained backbone), paragraph selection: utility labels beat relevance (primary reader)

families.name: R4b
families.claim: ours_beta > xprovence (same initialization family), paragraph selection (primary reader); not run if the xprovence arm is not run

families.name: R5
families.claim: ours_sent > span_ans_sent at 8x: utility labels beat the annotation-free answer-string label (primary reader)

families.name: R6
families.claim: ours_sent not worse than span_sent by more than 0.02 token F1 at 8x: no supporting-fact annotation, close to supporting-fact supervision (primary reader)

families.name: R7
families.claim: fuse_sent (rank fusion of ours_sent and span_sent, k=60) > span_sent at 8x: utility labels add to supporting-fact labels (primary reader)
